claims.summary: Studio evidence routines rotate by lesson before they reach slide-deck grounding.
Discussion notes, closing notes, warm-up grouping, and Course Map fallback checks vary deterministically.
Deliverable-facing modality grounding uses compact lesson-specific profile data instead of raw repeated course-level teaching patterns.
